description: Synthetic datasets sharing one known reference, to illustrate bias, spread and RMSE. Not data from, or a ranking of, the supplied Greenlee, ENTES or CIRCUTOR emulators.

assessment.interpretation: Errors are relative to the supplied reference. They describe accuracy only if that current was actually applied while the readings were taken; supplying a reference does not establish that. stddev_population_a is the spread of the readings, not accuracy.
